items.question: Under UAE labour accommodation rules, how many workers must an establishment employ, at a wage of AED 1,500 or less per month, before it must provide accommodation?
items.gold: Establishments employing 50 or more workers earning AED 1,500 or less per month must provide accommodation.
items.fact: Accommodation required for establishments employing 50+ low-wage workers.

items.question: What minimum floor area per person must bedrooms meet in UAE labour accommodation under the Ministerial Resolution No. 44 of 2022 framework?
items.gold: The area allocated for each person should not be less than 3 square metres.
items.fact: Labour accommodation bedrooms require at least 3 square metres per person.
